$description: CODE-OWNED. Font families, sizes, and line heights that Figma no longer exports as variables. The designer moved font weights to Figma (typography-primitive + typography-semantic) but kept sizes and families as text styles, not variables. If the designer adds these back to Figma, delete this file and let the sync own them.

fallback.$description: What renders when the UCSD faces are unavailable — which is EVERY machine that has not licensed them, including every developer's until the web licence is confirmed. Without a stack the browser falls back to its default serif, so a Tailwind page rendered in Times while the Bootstrap page beside it looked correct. Both targets now compile from these, so they degrade identically.

sans.$description: For roles set in the working face (Brix Sans).

display.$description: For roles set in the condensed display face (Refrigerator Deluxe). Leads with a condensed face so headings keep roughly their intended width.
display.$value: 'Arial Narrow', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

mono.$description: Code and tabular figures. UCSD licenses no monospace face, so the value IS the complete stack (no fallback token is appended). Backs Bootstrap's $font-family-monospace and Tailwind's font-mono, so both frameworks agree.
